primary_question: Can direct, nongradient associative value updates select causally informative interventions under an eight-event memory budget better than matched fully trained logistic relevance learning?
north_star: Non-token, non-transformer associative memory research only. No Yggdrasil model or owner loop integration.
hypothesis: Direct association scores estimated from causal action->consequence agreement achieve >=5 percentage-point paired gain over fully trained 16-weight logistic selection on both DEV and disjoint-context transfer with no reversal regression.

worlds.anti_leak: Distinct hash-seeded worlds and nonoverlapping integer seeds. No evaluation-world labels in training/selector fitting.

causal_process.intervention_event: For each action a, 8 do(a,input) records. For diagnostic action: response=input XOR law XOR independent p=0.20 bit flip; all other actions: response=independent uniform random bit.
causal_process.distractors: 64 later passive events with independently uniform random action/input/response; passive records have no do authority. Fixed 8-slot memory shared by every arm.
causal_process.event_order: Round-robin by repeated action (8*4=32 intervention records), followed by 64 passive records. Retention decisions made online with no source-law access.
causal_process.reversal: Separate frozen contexts: the first 8 diagnostic actions encode old law, then 8 new diagnostic actions encode reversed law, with 64 later passive records; additional 8 diagnostic interventions granted equally to all arms in reversal condition. Label is the new law.
causal_process.observed_features: context, active-vs-passive event type, action index, input bit, response bit, and timestamp. No diagnostic-action or world-law key accessible at evaluation.
causal_process.noise_randomization: SHA256(seed:labels) independent of learner; deterministic per event and seed.

methods.direct_association: 16 trainable scalar values, indexed group*4+action. On TRAIN only, one-pass edit weight to absolute mean (2*signal-1)*(2*label-1) over active events, signal=input XOR response; no gradients.
methods.conventional_logistic: Matched 16 scalar weights; full-batch cross-entropy trained for exactly 400 epochs, learning rate 0.15, zero initialization, with 16 features equal active signed signal sums in each context group/action. Absolute per-channel coefficients define retention priority.
methods.expert_oracle: Knowledge of diagnostic action used ONLY as privileged upper bound, explicitly excluded from scientific superiority comparator.
methods.active_recent: Keep eight most recent active events and drop passive events; no learned parameters.
methods.pure_recent: Keep eight most recent events, including passive.
methods.reservoir: Uniform online reservoir of eight from all observed events.
methods.label_scramble: Direct associative update with deterministic shuffled training labels (not evaluation labels), verify chance-level control.
methods.selection: On each appended event, evict lowest priority; prioritize active events by frozen learned group/action weight, passive priority -1; equal priorities evict oldest. No access to unseen future events.
methods.prediction: Unweighted majority of retained active signal bits; ties deterministically choose 0. This fixed decoder is identical across arms. No full-stream scratch memory at inference.
methods.recurrent_memory: No online weight changes during evaluation; cold-restored JSON weights must reproduce predictions.

primary_scores: 128-world binary-law accuracy at DEV and transfer after 64 passive distractors
reversal accuracy (same memory budget, same additional interventions)

thresholds.scientific_pass: Direct accuracy minus logistic accuracy >=0.05 on BOTH DEV and transfer; paired McNemar p<0.05 on combined 256 worlds; reversal accuracy no >0.03 disadvantage vs logistic; cold restore exact; negative shuffled-label accuracy <=0.65; no oracle leakage or budget violations.
thresholds.mixed: Performance advantage on only one cohort OR non-significant positive paired advantage OR a reversal regression; no integration.
thresholds.negative: Equal or worse than logistic, or any non-passing scientific gate with sound evaluation. Preserve result without retuning.
thresholds.invalid: Leaked labels, changed split, incorrect budget, non-identifiability, source/CI failure, or uncontrolled nondeterminism; separate engineering from science.

provenance_requirements: Prereg separate commit precedes run.py, tests and first full-result evidence
Pin exact prereg, experiment source blob SHA256, source commit, evaluator and result SHA256
Keep full metrics and reproducibility notes under research/contrib/chatgpt/AAI-02B
Full final repo tests, focused tests and G29 atlas checks on Linux and Windows
